_comment: Ground-truth FLAT solve of the 30-node fine TwoPodRail (no abstraction). This is the reason the topology is only 16 GPUs: unlike RailOptimizedSpineLeaf, the flat problem is small enough to solve directly, so the hierarchical result has something to be validated AGAINST rather than only self-consistency-checked. Copy-free LP AllGather, settings otherwise mirroring two_pod_rail_hierarchical_allgather.json so the two are comparable.
_expected: Same T* = 0.4267 as the hierarchical run (chunk_size 1 GB). A hierarchical makespan ABOVE this is the abstraction's cost; BELOW it means one of the two is wrong. Also compare the emitted per-flow rates: cross-pod 18.75 splitting 12.5 / 6.25 across the spines.
